summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature by reading and editing files only; no tests, mypy, Black, or other repository code were run, and nothing was committed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry returning "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, placed between show_cursor and set_alt_screen. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) with the title read from the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" section above "Fixed" with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (assertion skipped when legacy_windows is set), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Verification status: not executed; the changes are verified by reading only.
